crossRefs.note: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut…
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against…
for he put his life in his hand, and struck the Philistine, and Yahweh worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw…
Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and…
The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh, Micaiah the son of…
So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”
When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,
The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all…
forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them…
Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
“You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

translations.web: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
translations.bsb: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
translations.kjv: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
translations.asv: Evil shall slay the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be condemned.
